name: web-mobile-organizer-line-illustration-checklist-phone-scene
title: Mobile organizer illustration: a person taking a selfie beside a giant phone with checklist and calendar cards
whatItIs: A white-background line illustration of a woman taking a phone selfie, standing beside a giant phone outline displaying a checklist card (ticks, star, X marks) and a calendar/clock card, framed by orange paint-stroke accents and simple leaf plant illustrations.
whatItMeans: Clean and universally friendly; the loose line style and soft orange accents make a productivity app feel approachable rather than corporate.
techniques: Combine line illustration with soft flat colour accents.
Scale a checklist card to giant size as the scene's centrepiece.
Frame the scene with simple plant illustrations for warmth.

vocabulary.definition: Artwork drawn primarily with outline strokes.
A loose brush-like mark used as a decorative highlight.
